items.why: Fear is spiking as the Dow craters 1,000 points and the market enters a correction, with investors rushing for protection.
Nvidia is leading the resumption of the AI sell-off, with the Nasdaq down 4% as chip stocks erase some of Monday's rally.
Chip stocks are tumbling as the AI rout continues, with hot inflation and new Trump tariffs adding to the selling.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Nasdaq futures down 4.39% and S&P futures down 2.94% as the AI sell-off resumes.
summary: Stocks are selling off sharply this morning, led by Nvidia and AI chip names as the Nasdaq drops about 4% and the Dow falls 1,000 points. The VIX is surging as the correction spreads across tech.
